Sibling reports/components/ScheduleForm.tsx already carries a comment about a previously-fixed hardcoded-English leak, confirming this is an active i18n-debt class in this area — the forms pages were missed. Distinct from all prior ppt-web-ui i18n findings (vote-detail-hardcoded-en, dsa-reports-i18n, dialog-i18n-gap, registry-confirm-i18n), which were single components in other features.
